components.gap: Merin's definitions and complete argument are not all reconstructed on the routed text: (a) Definition 8(a) requires the value range of a relevance measure to be a subinterval, proper or improper, of the extended reals (p. 269); rationality-4-3 lines 172-180 state the joint-table dependence and differentiability but not this interval clause. (b) Definition 9 states that ordinal equivalence holds iff T' = f(T) for some isotonic f (p. 270, n. 9); rationality-4-3 lines 291-293 give only the direction that increasing transforms preserve rankings, and the converse is neither stated nor proved. (c) The p. 268 claim that, for mutually relevant A and B, A can be more relevant to B than B to A under one measure, less under another and equally under a third, is not realized by a model; the routed D and L direction comparisons (rationality-4-3 lines 235-245) run the same way. (d) The p. 272 general claim that any relevance measure affords some conditional homomorphisms is not stated or shown.

Merin's raven example is not presented as the source states it (p. 272): the predicament (1) H supported by A=A1A2, (2) the logical equivalent G supported by B=B1B2, (3) the white-shoe embellishment, and the deductivist criterion that logical equivalents be treated alike for support, which is what makes B's support of H paradoxical; rationality-4-3 lines 398-425 give the solution model but not the predicament and criterion. The routed classification of the chapter's claims by kind (w02b-p15-024 lines 37-61, 'three' empirical claims) does not classify every non-formal claim of the chapter, e.g. the Mercury judgment report (p. 268), the Linda response report and the delta-p evidence report (p. 273), and the popularity of relevance theory in linguistics (p. 273).

Not every promised mathematical claim of the source extent is accounted for: the equivalence asserted in Definition 9 (ordinal equivalence iff an isotonic transformation exists, p. 270) is used but its converse direction is not proved, and the existential direction claim of p. 268 (more, less and equally relevant under three measures) is neither proved nor exhibited. The dependent-source set itself is fixed at w02b-p15-024 lines 963-1031.
